alacrity: Alacer: brisk. She accepted with alacrity.
Alacrity: bounces up to say yes.
anathema: Anathema: cursed. Lying is anathema to him.
Anathema: the thing you can’t stand.
apogee: Apo + gaia: away from earth. The apogee of his career.
Apogee: the top of the orbit.
apostate: Apo + stasis: standing away. An apostate leaves the faith.
arrant: Arrant = errant, thorough. An arrant fool.
artless: Without art or trickery. An artless smile.
attenuate: Ad + tenuis: thin. Attenuate the sound.
beg: To beg the question: dodge it by circular logic.
Beg the question: assume what you must prove.
byzantine: Byzantium’s court: intrigue. A byzantine bureaucracy.
cow: Cow: scare. Cowed by the bully.
defray: De + frais: pay costs. Defray expenses.
diatribe: Dia + tribein: wear away. A diatribe against taxes.
equivocate: Equi + vocare: equal voices. Don’t equivocate!
exegesis: Ex + hegeisthai: lead out. Biblical exegesis.
expansive: Expand: spread out. An expansive mood.
expunge: Ex + pungere: prick out. Expunge the record.
hector: Hector: Trojan hero turned bully. Hector the staff.
imbibe: In + bibere: drink in. Imbibe wine; imbibe ideas.
insufferable: In + suffer: unbearable. An insufferable show-off.
jingoist: Jingo song. A jingoist yells “Our country first!”.
kowtow: Chinese ketou: knock the head. Kowtow to the boss.
nadir: Arabic: opposite. The nadir of his career.
pariah: Tamil paraiyar: drummer caste. A social pariah.
perfunctory: Per + fungi: get through. A perfunctory glance.
precipitate: Prae + caput: head first. A precipitate decision.
prosaic: Prosa: plain speech. A prosaic life.
supercilious: Super + cilium: raised eyebrow. A supercilious sneer.
untoward: Not toward: improper. Nothing untoward happened.
zeitgeist: German: time-spirit. The zeitgeist of the 60s.
